_about: A SYNTHETIC conversation, four dated sessions, written for this repository. It exists because every published measurement of this project is document question-answering, while the half its name promises — a memory that lives across sessions — had no current number at all. It is small and it is invented; it is not a substitute for LongMemEval, and it is not evidence about any real corpus. What it does is exercise the classes this project has recorded as open: a fact the speaker supersedes, a quantity that must be composed across sessions, an ordering, a preference stated once and asked about in other words, and questions whose discriminating word the conversation never writes.
_scoring: Golds are chosen so that the OPPOSITE answer cannot contain them. 'Who is the manager' golds on the later name, not on the word 'manager'; the ordering question is asked as yes/no so that naming the other event scores nothing.
